test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm, then 50% of the length of PA (in cm) is:
solution:
**Given data:**

AB = 7 cm

CD = 1 cm

PD = 5 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e67eb472bdf2b59920e92a3b2a2a36f73ef411461d740965b078ef5121833f2.png] 

From the basic proportionality theorem,

PB × PA = PD × PC

Substituting the values-

⇒ PB × (7 + PB) = 5 × (5 + 1)

⇒ PB × (7 + PB) = 5 × 6 = 30

⇒ PB² + 7PB -30 = 0

⇒ PB2 + 10PB - 3PB -30 = 0

⇒ PB × (PB + 10) - 3 × (PB + 10) = 0

⇒ (PB - 3) × (PB + 10) = 0

Either PB = 3 or -10 (PB cannot be negative. Hence, PB = 3)

∴ PA = AB + BP = 7 + 3 = 10

Now,

⇒ 50% of PA = 50 × 10/100 = 5

∴ **The value of 50% PA is 5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** The equation PB × (7 + PB) = 30 could be solved by breaking 30 into appropriate factors to match the equation PB × (7 + PB).

⇒ 30 = 10 × 3 and 10 = 7 + 3

∴ 30 = 3 × (7 + 3)

⇒ PB × (7 + PB) = 3 × (7 + 3)

∴ PB = 3 cm and PA = 10 cm

⇒ 50% of PA = 50 × 10/100 = 5

∴ The value of 50% PA is 5 cm.
